result.title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
result.summary: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 R2A 在线 VLN 适应框架，用成功/失败导航记忆按指令检索经验，并以冻结预训练策略为锚强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹，实现无源域数据的持续策略更新。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按任务检索正负经验并做对比式轨迹训练、辅以冻结策略约束行为漂移的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹级监督与贡献分配提供线索，可供核查；但本身不涉及 latent 视觉推理状态。
